options.label: Push branch to origin/main directly
options.description: `git push origin worktree-bridge-cse_01RY...:main` from this worktree. origin/main fast-forwards to include the 2 prior local commits + my fix. The main checkout stays untouched (its local main lags origin/main by 1, but its dirty files are intact). Daemon-on-disk still old until someone refreshes; I can then overlay just my 2 files into the working dir with `git show origin/main:path > path` and restart the daemon, leaving the dirty 4 files alone.

options.label: Stash dirty work, FF merge in main, pop stash
options.description: From main checkout: `git stash -u` → `git merge --ff-only` the bridge branch → `git push` → `git stash pop`. Standard flow but momentarily disturbs the parallel session's working state, and the pop could conflict if that session is mid-write.

options.label: Ask the other session first
options.description: Stop here; surface that there's a parallel CLAUDE_BIN refactor in flight and let you coordinate with that session before I touch main.
